name: nutridesk
description: NutriDesk | Ernährung & Finanzen für den Desktop
author: Tobias

scripts.build:mac: printf '// prod build\n' > src/renderer/assets/env.js && TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY=$(cat src-tauri/nutridesk.key) TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD='' tauri build --bundles app dmg
scripts.build:mac:dev: printf 'window.__API_BASE="http://localhost:3180";window.__DEV__=true;\n' > src/renderer/assets/env.js && TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY=$(cat src-tauri/nutridesk.key) TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD='' tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json --bundles app dmg
